name: alakazam_ml_v17
model: The distilled LightGBM weights, feature set, and narrow reversible scope are unchanged from v15. v17 adds only deterministic attack-state memory, a narrow immediate-KO pivot, and a persistent Team Rocket's Articuno breaker.
model_scope: Live ML retains v15's safe Abra/Dunsparce bench-role choice and same-evolution-card target choice. Attack, Energy, Trainer, Boss, Hammer, retreat, abilities, and END remain deterministic.
ml_override_environment: ALAKAZAM_ML_V17_ENABLE_OVERRIDE=0 disables the inherited guarded live scope; the v15 flag remains a compatibility fallback.

v17_rule_changes: Remember attack-disable effects for the exact Active identity and retreat to a ready attacker.
Pair qualifying immunity attacks with coin results and reject attacks against a heads-protected exact Active until identity change or expiry.
Evaluate Active-Alakazam attach-retreat-benched-Alakazam attack only when it creates an immediate KO.
Persist an Articuno breaker state, concentrate three Energy on Fezandipiti ex, and promote it only when attack-ready.
Prioritize Cruel Arrow into Team Rocket's Articuno and Boss's Orders into unprotected evolved Team Rocket Pokemon.
